description: Create a formal ADA reasonable accommodation request document. Review the reference files in /home/ga/Documents/ADA_Request/ (medical_notes.txt, accommodation_examples.txt, ada_rights_summary.txt, job_duties.txt). Create a professional business letter with: (1) formal header with date and recipient, (2) subject line referencing ADA/accommodation, (3) section explaining medical condition with documentation reference, (4) section with at least 3 specific accommodation requests, (5) section explaining how accommodations help job performance, (6) closing requesting meeting/discussion. Use professional formatting (bold headers, appropriate spacing). Save as /home/ga/Documents/ADA_Request/accommodation_request.docx
